title: parse_amount reintroduces binary float error
instruction: test_entries.py::test_parse_amount_from_float_is_exact_to_cents is failing. Amounts parsed from float values carry binary rounding error, so 0.1 + 0.2 does not equal 0.3. Fix parse_amount in the ledger package so float amounts are parsed exactly. Do not change the tests. Run tests/test_entries.py.

ground_truth.why_multi_file: The fix is local, but the reasoning is in the parse_amount docstring, which explains why float must go through str.
